full_judgment: 19. It is an established principle that the plaintiff is bound to prove his case. The plaintiffs witnesses did not support his claim that he signed the document believing the same to be an agreement for a cinema hall. The plaintiff has therefore not satisfied his burden of proof under section 101 of the Evidence Act. Moreover, the disputed deed shows that the land was valued at Tk. 3000/- which casts doubt on the claim that the transfer was by way of gift.
